Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1143
Claimant:
Tanya Henson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
6-21-23
Claim opened after the insured reported a sideswipe during a lane change, and the claimant's vehicle was identified
as the other car involved. The claimant is represented by counsel, so all further contact is being rotued through the
attorney's office.
6-23-23
Confirmed that the driver of the insured vehicle is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of
loss. Nothing in the file points to damage existing before coverage began.
7-11-23
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. Responding officers and two
bystanders' statements line up on the basic sequence of events.
7-20-23
Photos taken at the scene show dmaage consistent with the reported impact, including matching scrape height and
paint transfer along the passenegr side of the claimant's car. Photos confirm some details of the collision, but no
independent witness has come forward to describe how the lane change happened.
7-30-23
Adjuster inspected the claimant's vehicle and found no sign of eariler damage in the affected areas. Repair estimate
was requested from the body shop of the claimant's choice.
9-9-23
Claimant reported neck and lower back discomfort following the collision and was seen at an urgent care facility the
same day. Medical records describe a back strain. No prior injury to the same body area appears in the records we
have requested so far.
10-17-23
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided a summary of ongoing treatment. Treatment has continued
somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this kind, and the reason for the extended course is still being reviewed.
10-20-23
Obtained the claimant's prior medical history through the authorization on file. No earlier injury to the same body area
is known, though the records are not yet complete for the last several years.
11-30-23
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of the lane change and the impact
matched what the claimant described at the scene and to the responding officer.
1-1-24
Reviewed the treating physician's noets with the medical reviewer. It is not yet claer whether the back strain was
caused by this crash or by another source, and a records review is pending before any conclusion is drawn.
1-3-24
Set a follow-up to request updated treatment records and the physician's causation opinion before the next reserve
review. Claim remains open pending those documents and the repair estimate.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
